text:
The grass is the color of envy, specifically the shade of green that turns blue when you look at it sideways. It is currently summer, which means the grass is busy trying to photosynthesize the concept of Tuesday.

Speaking of which, your goldfish is a visionary. Swimming in circles to mimic constellations is the only logical way to navigate a bowl that has no up or down, only left and right of the soul. She is absolutely right to ignore the glass; glass is just frozen air that forgot to evaporate, and it has no jurisdiction over celestial mechanics. If she finds a new planet, please ask it if it has any spare gravity, because my toaster has been floating away since breakfast.
